name: Ashes to Ashes, Stuffing to Dust
source:
Speeding along an icy tundra, at 70 miles per hour, in a box-within-a-box are...

The Yunka. 

The Yunka are, innately, very special.

Ethereal demigods and goddesses; (they are beyond the binary) beings of immense power within their own dominions.

Amongst even the boisterous Yunka is Yunyun; a menace dead-set on causing the biggest ruckus during the big going-away party.

This is an exciting soiree, but also one of deep sorrow.

You see, the Yunka will, very soon, all go their separate ways... 


And Yunyun is sure they'll find a master of their own... 

Perhaps a cyclops samurai with heated gamma rays...

 

...But Yunyun cannot even begin to fathom the horrors of what fate might have in store for them...

[From [url=https://ndroz833.itch.io/ashes-to-ashes-stuffing-to-dust]itch.io[/url]]
